# This folder is generated

It **is** kinderminds.nz: every file here is published, and nothing else is.
It is produced by `_build/publish.js` in `../2026-KM-Build`, which holds the
site along with its sources, tooling and experiments.

**Do not edit anything here.** The next publish overwrites changes and deletes
additions, without asking. Make the change in `../2026-KM-Build` and run
`node _build/publish.js`.

The project context, architecture notes and gotchas all live there too.
